newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Dave & Buster's estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Dave & Buster's estimates raised.

text.p: -- Hanifen Imhoff Inc on Tuesday raised its estimate for Dave & Buster's Inc fourth-quarter and full-year earnings to reflect stronger-than-expected initial sales volumes at the company's unit at the White Flint Mall in Atlanta.
-- Hanifen analyst Christopher Weis raised his fourth-quarter estimate by $0.01 a share to $0.27 and his 1996 estimate by $0.01 to $0.86. His estimate for 1997 remains $1.12, he said.
-- Shares of Dave & Buster's, which operates a chain of restaurant/entertainment complexes, closed up 1/8 at 18-1/2 in trading on the Nasdaq.
